Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the verb’s argument structure. “Maktay” functions like “is pleasing to,” making the experiencer (“I”) the object and the liked item (“apples”) the subject. The translation should follow V-DO-S with object = “Mato” (accusative “me”) and subject = “Apple” (nominative), yielding “Maktay Mato Apple.” Instead, the agent used “Zapple” (accusative) as the object and “Pa” (nominative) as the subject, producing “Maktay Zapple Pa,” which reverses the roles.
